active_checks.source: Start from input/initial.blend and use the single supplied reference image. Preserve everything outside the permitted changes described above, including all cameras, render and colour-management settings. Render main.png from the supplied main camera. For alternate.png, copy that camera and translate it 0.30 m along its local positive X axis without changing its rotation or lens. Keep both cameras and the same edited scene in scene.blend. Pack all dependencies. Do not replace the scene with a reference image plane or retrieve the original complete scene from the internet. Hidden details may be inferred plausibly. Retain the original scene scale and Z-up orientation.

The pit buildings and covered grandstand have been removed from this stylized raceway. Rebuild the arrangement shown in input/reference.png: three adjoining pit garages along one side of the straight, an office block at the end of that row, and a separate covered stepped grandstand on the opposite side. Restore the garage bays facing the track with recessed openings, dividing piers and a continuous roof line. The office should read as a distinct end section with its visible window band. The grandstand needs individual seating tiers, supporting side walls, an open viewing face and an overhanging roof with real thickness and support. Align the structures with the surviving track, barriers and start gantry, preserving the gaps needed to enter the garage bays and keeping the racing surface unobstructed. Match the light concrete, red accent surfaces, dark glazing and compact cartoon proportions. Tiny signs may be simplified into colour blocks. Do not change the cars, road, barriers, gantry, terrain, camera or lights.

score_aggregation_note:
## 当前复评口径：v8 / Strict fidelity review

仅复评原作品，未改动原生成题面。逐题原图/文本特征；主视图必查，跨视图项必须核对所有公开原图和候选双视图。
每项列出达成、差异和严重度后评0–4级；主要缺陷最多2级，主体错误/缺失0级，不能因制作精致掩盖不忠于参考。
保持原总权重及自动/物理测量：Brief VLM60/测量30/物理10；Edit 数值20/目标30/保持20/物理10/VLM20；Reference 图像50/定位20/物理10/VLM20。
定位沿用原冻结参考框及公式，重新独立识别候选框。禁止任意配准。未展示仅扣对应项；技术失败不补零。
机器草案和裁判尚待人工校准，不声称人工认证。详见 harness/vlm_spec.json。
